name: Employee Onboarding Orchestration Engine (HR · IT · IAM · SaaS)

parameters.content:
## Employee Onboarding Orchestration Engine

Receives a new-hire payload and orchestrates provisioning across HR, IAM, IT and SaaS systems in a controlled sequence with status tracking, retries and a final summary.

### All nodes (1-line each)
1. Webhook - New Hire Request – Receives the employee onboarding payload via POST.
2. Code - Validate & Normalize – Validates required fields and normalizes the employee record.
3. Wait - Pre HR – Short pause before calling the HR system.
4. HTTP Request - HR System – Creates or updates the employee record in the HRIS.
5. Code - Process HR Result – Checks HR response and prepares the IAM payload.
6. Wait - Pre IAM – Pause before identity provisioning.
7. HTTP Request - IAM / Identity – Creates the user identity, groups and initial access.
8. Code - Process IAM Result – Extracts the new user ID and prepares IT + SaaS payloads.
9. Wait - Pre IT – Pause before IT provisioning.
10. HTTP Request - IT Provisioning – Creates email, device ticket and core IT accounts.
11. Code - Process IT Result – Confirms IT resources and prepares SaaS calls.
12. Wait - Pre SaaS – Pause before SaaS application provisioning.
13. HTTP Request - SaaS Apps – Provisions access to Slack, Google Workspace, Notion, etc.
14. Code - Build Final Status – Aggregates results from all systems into a single status object.
15. Code - Finalize Response – Assembles the final onboarding report for the caller.
16. Respond to Webhook – Returns the complete onboarding status to the caller.

## 1. Intake & HR

Webhook - New Hire Request – Receives the employee onboarding payload via POST.
Code - Validate & Normalize – Validates required fields and normalizes the employee record.
Wait - Pre HR – Short pause before calling the HR system.
HTTP Request - HR System – Creates or updates the employee record in the HRIS.
Code - Process HR Result – Checks HR response and prepares the IAM payload.

## 2. IAM & IT

Wait - Pre IAM – Pause before identity provisioning.
HTTP Request - IAM / Identity – Creates the user identity, groups and initial access.
Code - Process IAM Result – Extracts the new user ID and prepares IT + SaaS payloads.
Wait - Pre IT – Pause before IT provisioning.
HTTP Request - IT Provisioning – Creates email, device ticket and core IT accounts.
Code - Process IT Result – Confirms IT resources and prepares SaaS calls.

## 3. SaaS & Finish

Wait - Pre SaaS – Pause before SaaS application provisioning.
HTTP Request - SaaS Apps – Provisions access to Slack, Google Workspace, Notion, etc.
Code - Build Final Status – Aggregates results from all systems into a single status object.
Code - Finalize Response – Assembles the final onboarding report for the caller.
Respond to Webhook – Returns the complete onboarding status to the caller.
